rule: A newest-class model joins the mill rotation only with (a) a release date from a primary source inside the 30-day window, (b) an open licence that allows evaluation and needs no gated click-through (the kernel holds no HF token), (c) a GGUF whose general.architecture is in upstream llama.cpp (src/llama-arch.cpp) and whose Ollama manifest carries a chat template, (d) weights that fit one Kaggle T4 (16 GB) with room for the KV cache, and (e) a manifest digest pinned HERE before the kernel runs. The kernel halts if the pulled manifest differs from the pin. Our own models are never eligible.
pin_method: sha256 of the manifest bytes served by the Ollama registry protocol (GET https://huggingface.co/v2/<ns>/<repo>/manifests/<quant>, Accept application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json). Validated 2026-09-28: the same method applied to registry.ollama.ai/v2/library/qwen2.5/manifests/7b reproduces the 3090 pin 845dbda0... exactly. Fetched twice per model; both fetches identical.

models.gguf_repo: ggml-org/MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B-GGUF (the llama.cpp org; Q8_0 is the only quant it publishes)
models.gguf_architecture: qwen35 (present in llama.cpp llama-arch.cpp master, read 2026-09-28)
models.template: Qwen im_start chat template with an empty <think></think> prefill (non-thinking mode); stop list includes <think>
models.notes: Vision-capable base (Qwen3.5-9B); the manifest carries a 624 MB projector layer. The mill sends text only.

models.release_source: https://huggingface.co/api/models/openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B createdAt 2026-09-06 (lab's own repo; GGUF repo created 2026-09-05)
models.template: im_start chat template with an empty <think></think> prefill (non-thinking mode)
models.notes: Q8_0 chosen over Q4_K_M: at 2.5B the fidelity cost of 4-bit is not worth saving 1 GB.
